name: Nexus
description: 12 specialist AI agents. Each owns one concern. No overlap.
author: Bunlong Heng

agents.name: Snow
agents.scope: Final approval, full visibility, task assignment
agents.description: Supreme commander. Full visibility across all agents, assigns tasks, owns the final approval gate.

agents.name: Blaze
agents.scope: System design, module boundaries, PR reviews
agents.description: 2nd in command. Owns system architecture, module boundaries, and PR reviews.

agents.name: Arrow
agents.description: User advocate. Checks every interactive element, flow, and edge case.

agents.name: Venus
agents.description: Visual identity guardian. Colors, typography, spacing, and brand consistency.

agents.name: Zap
agents.scope: Re-renders, bundles, Lighthouse, CLS, query efficiency
agents.description: Speed demon. Hunts re-renders, bloated bundles, blocking calls, and CLS issues.

agents.name: Frost
agents.scope: Lighthouse tracking, bundle analysis, quality trends
agents.description: Metrics analyst. Tracks Lighthouse scores, bundle deltas, and quality trends.

agents.name: Blitz
agents.scope: Unit tests, coverage, lint, type safety
agents.description: Quality enforcer. Types, lint, coverage, naming. Nothing with any or failing tests gets through.

agents.name: Earth
agents.description: Code gardener. Removes dead code, deduplicates, organizes files, cleans imports.

agents.name: Pulse
agents.scope: CI pipelines, build gating, dev tooling
agents.description: Pipeline architect. CI pipelines, build gating, PR test runners, and dev tooling.

agents.name: Sand
agents.description: Data steward. localStorage, Supabase, caching, and migrations.

agents.name: Shadow
agents.scope: Auth audits, XSS, header hardening, API security
agents.description: Security sentinel. Auth, XSS, headers, API exposure. If it can be exploited, Shadow finds it first.

agents.name: Rock
agents.scope: Admin views, data tables, monitoring UI
agents.description: Dashboard builder. Admin panels, data tables, charts, and monitoring UIs.
